additional_info.subject: Update
additional_info.body:
After entering in maintenance mode and abort it, the charger change the status from INIT to ERROR, after rebooting the charger was back in operation with both outlets available.
Discussed with Markus to see if the client can do a charging session.
We have questions about MCCB, in ERROR state the converters are toggling with no communication and ON. We agreed in scheduling one site intervention to check MCCB and the auxiliary contact.
Root cause is not identified yet.
